<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The sparks are compelled to be refined and desire it, but their concealment can appear as an obstacle until the awakening of the Yechidah reveals their true yearning.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="2">that since the intent of the descent and fall of the sparks is in order that they be refined and return to their source</t>
    <t s="3">[through which they will ascend higher than they were before their descent],</t>
    <t s="4">therefore there cannot be any prevention or delay</t>
    <t s="5">(from the side of the sparks)</t>
    <t s="6">to their refinement.</t>
    <t s="7">For that which it is possible for there to be prevention or delay is only from the side of the person</t>
    <t s="8">(the one who refines),</t>
    <t s="9">who has free choice,</t>
    <t s="10">but from the side of the sparks—they are compelled to be refined.</t>
    <t s="11">[And this is the meaning of what is said, “and Adoniram over the tax,”</t>
    <t s="12">Adoniram is “Adoni Ram” (my Lord is exalted),</t>
    <t s="13">“Adoni” is analogous to the Name Ado-nai</t>
    <t s="14">(the aspect of His Shechinah)</t>
    <t s="15">and “Ram” from the term “exaltedness” is the light of Ein Sof that is above the worlds</t>
    <t s="16">(the Holy One, blessed be He).</t>
    <t s="17">And according to what is explained below</t>
    <t s="18">(section 10)</t>
    <t s="19">that the matter of the refinements is to unite the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,</t>
    <t s="20">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="21">that “the tax” is the matter of the refinements.</t>
    <t s="22">And it is called by the name “tax,”</t>
    <t s="23">for a tax is something that is compelled to be paid.</t>
    <t s="24">And the aspect of Adoniram is that which compels the collection of the tax,</t>
    <t s="25">the refinement of the sparks].</t>
    <t s="26">And moreover,</t>
    <t s="27">the sparks want and yearn to be refined.</t>
    <t s="28">And this is “for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="29">that the sparks that are found in the aspect of “many”</t>
    <t s="30">(the public domain,</t>
    <t s="31">the mountains of separation)</t>
    <t s="32">yearn that they be refined</t>
    <t s="33">[similar to the simple meaning of “for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="34">that the men of Avshalom prayed for the victory of Dovid].</t>
    <t s="35">However, since the sparks are in exile in the aspect of “many,”</t>
    <t s="36">this is not revealed.</t>
    <t s="37">And even to the extent that sometimes it appears to the person that the matters of the world</t>
    <t s="38">(not only do they not assist,</t>
    <t s="39">but rather)</t>
    <t s="40">prevent him from the service of G-d,</t>
    <t s="41">for the concealment of the sparks is a concealment to the utmost,</t>
    <t s="42">like a concealment that is as if non-existent.</t>
    <t s="43">And through the service of “for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="44">the awakening of the Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="45">the essence of the soul that is above extension</t>
    <t s="46">(existence),</t>
    <t s="47">the concealment that is as if non-existent of the sparks is awakened and revealed,</t>
    <t s="48">and their yearning to be refined,</t>
    <t s="49">the matter of “for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="50">and then it is seen in revelation that the matters of the world</t>
    <t s="51">(not only do they not prevent,</t>
    <t s="52">but rather)</t>
    <t s="53">assist in the service of G-d.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The peace of refinement through the service of “for many were with me” is complete, encompassing both modes of refinement and transforming opposition.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is “He redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="2">that the peace of the refinement through the service of “for many were with me”</t>
    <t s="3">(the awakening of the Yechidah)</t>
    <t s="4">is in perfection,</t>
    <t s="5">for it includes both virtues</t>
    <t s="6">(as above, section 6),</t>
    <t s="7">for through the service of “for many were with me,”</t>
    <t s="8">the awakening of the Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="9">it is revealed that the sparks that are in exile in</t>
    <t s="10">(the public domain)</t>
    <t s="11">“many were with me”</t>
    <t s="12">(the will and yearning of them to be refined),</t>
    <t s="13">and therefore even the refinement in the manner from above to below has within it something of the virtue that the refinement is from the side of the lower,</t>
    <t s="14">for even this refinement is that the lower wants to be refined</t>
    <t s="15">(except that the actual refinement is through the revelation of a light that is above it).</t>
    <t s="16">And likewise conversely,</t>
    <t s="17">that even the refinement in the manner from below to above is in a way that the opposition of the lower is nullified.</t>
    <t s="18">For this that was explained above</t>
    <t s="19">(section 5)</t>
    <t s="20">that even after the refinement of the lower</t>
    <t s="21">(refinement in the manner from below to above)</t>
    <t s="22">the opposition of it still remains in concealment,</t>
    <t s="23">it is,</t>
    <t s="24">because the refinement of the lower is a matter that is added to it</t>
    <t s="25">(through the one who refines that is enclothed in it),</t>
    <t s="26">contrary to the nature of the lower.</t>
    <t s="27">And like the animal soul that by its nature is drawn to physical matters,</t>
    <t s="28">and the love for G-d</t>
    <t s="29">[that is made within it through the G-dly soul that is enclothed in it]</t>
    <t s="30">is contrary to its nature.</t>
    <t s="31">And from this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="32">that when the lower is in a way that even before the enclothing of the one who refines in it</t>
    <t s="33">(the service of refinement)</t>
    <t s="34">it wants and yearns</t>
    <t s="35">(in revelation)</t>
    <t s="36">to be refined,</t>
    <t s="37">then,</t>
    <t s="38">the refinement is not something additional to it,</t>
    <t s="39">and certainly it is not contrary to its nature,</t>
    <t s="40">and therefore its refinement</t>
    <t s="41">(even the refinement in the manner of enclothing)</t>
    <t s="42">is in the manner of the matter of transformation.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The entire service is to unite the Holy One and His Shechinah, and specifically through Yaakov, who embodies the revelation of the Yechidah, this unification encompasses both modes of refinement.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And behold, it is known</t>
    <t s="3">that the entirety of the matter of service is to unite the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah.</t>
    <t s="4">And this is the matter of the unification of Sovev and Memaleh,</t>
    <t s="5">for the Holy One, blessed be He, is the aspect of Sovev Kol Almin and the Shechinah is the aspect of Memaleh Kol Almin.</t>
    <t s="6">And this is what Yaakov said, “and I will return in peace to my father’s house, and HaVaYaH will be my G-d,”</t>
    <t s="7">that through the service of the refinements</t>
    <t s="8">(“and I will return in peace to my father’s house,”</t>
    <t s="9">the return of the sparks to their source)</t>
    <t s="10">[the primary service for which the soul descended below is the service of the refinements]</t>
    <t s="11">will be “and HaVaYaH will be my G-d,”</t>
    <t s="12">the unification of HaVaYaH</t>
    <t s="13">(Sovev)</t>
    <t s="14">and Elokim</t>
    <t s="15">(Memaleh).</t>
    <t s="16">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="17">that through the service of the refinements in the two manners</t>
    <t s="18">(in the manner from above to below and in the manner from below to above),</t>
    <t s="19">and in a way that each of them is included in both,</t>
    <t s="20">through this,</t>
    <t s="21">the unification of Sovev and Memaleh is in the two manners,</t>
    <t s="22">the drawing down of Sovev into Memaleh and the elevation of Memaleh into Sovev,</t>
    <t s="23">and in a way that each of them is included in both.</t>
    <t s="24">And according to this, it is possible to explain the connection of this matter specifically to Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="25">for the inclusion of the two manners in the service of the refinements, in each of which there are the two virtues,</t>
    <t s="26">is through the revelation of the aspect of the Yechidah,</t>
    <t s="27">above limitation,</t>
    <t s="28">and this that it is said of Yaakov</t>
    <t s="29">“and you shall spread forth to the west and to the east and to the north and to the south,”</t>
    <t s="30">an inheritance without borders,</t>
    <t s="31">is because there was in him the revelation of the Yechidah</t>
    <t s="32">(as was explained above).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
